conclusions: Budget is enabled with a 5 USD ceiling and 65.486681 USD internally accounted or held. The reservation ledger matches the budget exactly; this is not a provider invoice.
55.1 USD remains held across 218 LLM and 3 STT unsettled reservations. Recorded settlements/estimates total 10.386681 USD; source-labelled MEASURED is not independently reconciled provider billing.
No duplicate reservation or usage operation IDs were found. 181 MEASURED reservations have no retained matching usage record. This does not prove those calls were absent or duplicated.
The live service-role admission function retains its ceiling check and excludes anon/authenticated from EXECUTE. No mutating admission request was invoked by this audit.

None of the five deployed Edge packages contains the cleanup fix. Three budget helpers exactly match source baseline c9403455; publication-evaluate and qa-classify have different helpers but both retain the same unguarded reader cleanup. The fix is source-tested only; any future deployment must preserve each current complete package and review these differences.
Model identifier strings describe observed source/ledger data, not externally verified model availability or pricing. Current configured secret/environment values were not requested.

Observed helper drift: publication-evaluate v30 and qa-classify v29 carry a 262144-byte LLM request limit and 8192 output tokens, while source c9403455 and the other three deployed helpers carry 10485760 bytes and 2048 output tokens. QA v29 also predates explicit cancellation races in the reservation fetch/body. No limit changes or package replacement were performed.
